run_detection_training: run the transformer detector training loop on a COCO dataset with configurable backbone and optimizer
run_detection_evaluation: run evaluation of a trained transformer detector model on a test dataset with bbox and mask metrics
run_detection_resume: resume transformer detector training from a saved checkpoint file with the original optimizer and scheduler state
run_detection_distributed: run distributed transformer detector training across multiple GPUs using DistributedDataParallel
review_get_args_parser: review the get_args_parser function that defines all training, model, and dataset CLI arguments for the detector
